# RegexMatchDetail

Finds the first match of a regular expression in text, with its position and its capture groups.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RegexMatchDetail(text, pattern)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to search. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `pattern` | string | The regular expression, in ECMAScript syntax with no flags. A pattern that is not valid is a runtime error, as is a search that runs past the time limit for regular expressions the host sets (one second unless the host sets another). |

## Returns

Object. An object for the first, leftmost match, with three properties: match, the text matched; index, the position in text where it begins, counted from 0 in UTF-16 code units; and groups, an array of the text of each capture group in order, null for a group that took no part in the match. Null when pattern matches nowhere in text.

## Example

`RegexMatchDetail("id: 42", "([a-z]+): ([0-9]+)")` returns `{"match": "id: 42", "index": 0, "groups": ["id", "42"]}`.
